ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels and 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Centered white field bounded by a thick black margin, containing six distinct circular black spots distributed mid-lobe. Right lobe: Central white field with high-frequency black speckling and a dense concentration of linear black markings near the distal trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide U-shaped depression; interior pixel angle estimated at 135 degrees; notch depth is approximately 12% of the vertical span of the visible lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays four primary jagged peaks with amplitudes of 10-15 pixels. Right lobe trailing edge is smoother proximally, transitioning to high-frequency serrations at the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges tapering to sharp distal points; leading edges are obscured by the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Six circular dark pigment clusters on the left lobe center; clusters of high-intensity white calcified masses (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three parallel, curved dark lines (rake marks) on the upper margin of the right lobe; similar but less distinct linear disruptions on the upper margin of the left lobe near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring on both lobes and barnacle colonization on the distal trailing edges.
